text: One night, the single mother Carla Moran is [raped in her Los Angeles bungalow by an invisible assailant|threat|something unseen], and the attacks keep coming, at home, in her car, in front of her children. Her psychiatrist, Dr. Sneiderman, [believes it is all a delusion born of old trauma|rules|no one believes you], and her boyfriend leaves after witnessing it. Two parapsychologists take her seriously and build a full copy of her house to [freeze the thing in liquid helium|images|household objects and machines], and Carla tells it that it may kill her but will never have her.
